title: Machine-readable skill contracts
source: Deep research review of PR #1 and current SolKraft architecture
invariants: semantic relevance, admissibility, execution authority, and verification remain separate
missing metadata means unknown, never safe
contracts describe required authority but never grant it
SKILL.md remains lazily loaded after selection
core contract verification is declarative and non-executable
execution_authorized remains false at the SolKraft boundary

milestones.title: Correct the prototype
milestones.goal: Remove misleading safety assumptions and make route status truthful.

milestones.title: Contract v1
milestones.goal: Create a stable, portable, versioned contract data product.

milestones.title: Contract-aware routing
milestones.goal: Use admissibility before composition and route validation after composition.

milestones.title: Capability model
milestones.goal: Replace scalar auth enforcement with capability/resource requirements.

milestones.title: Typed dataflow
milestones.goal: Use typed inputs and outputs to improve composition.

milestones.title: Verification and trust
milestones.goal: Verify outcomes from evidence and expose provenance/trust.

milestones.title: Interfaces and CI
milestones.goal: Make contracts ordinary across API, CLI, MCP, contributions, docs, and CI.

milestones.title: Scale and interoperability
milestones.goal: Keep routing efficient at thousands of skills and interoperate with external metadata.

milestones.title: Migration and cleanup
milestones.goal: Migrate bundled skills and retire prototype shortcuts only after parity is proven.

program_acceptance: every discovered skill has an explicit contract state
unknown metadata never becomes a no-effect assertion
Contract v1 is portable, versioned, digest-bound, and JSON-Schema validated
routing performs pre-admissibility, composition, full-route validation, and bounded repair/recomposition
new contracts use capability/resource sets rather than scalar auth
verification is declarative by default and consumes structured evidence
trust and provenance are visible and cannot be self-elevated
Python, REST, CLI, MCP, contribution tooling, generated docs, and CI share semantics
prototype shortcuts are removed only after tested replacements exist
